name: BTS T-100 Segment Summary by Origin Airport
publisher: US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS)
notes: Socrata dataset r495-tyji; departing-passenger totals by origin airport-month, domestic/intl split, no imputation (NULL stays NULL).

name: BTS T-100 Segment (All Carriers), route level
publisher: US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS)
notes: Route-level (origin/dest/class) departures and distance, aggregated from the TranStats FMG ZIP; distance kept as max non-null value seen per route.

name: BTS On-Time Performance (Reporting Carrier)
publisher: US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS)
notes: Domestic reporting-carrier on-time performance only; congestion/delay figures from this source never cover international departures.

name: OurAirports airports.csv
vintage: current snapshot as of fetch (not a time series)
notes: closed-type rows dropped before insert; a duplicate active iata_code fails ingest loudly rather than silently picking one.

name: FAA Terminal Area Forecast (TAF)
notes: unconstrained forecast (assumes capacity is provided), not produced by this agent; FAA fiscal years run Oct-Sep, context only, never used in scoring/ranking.

name: OurAirports runways.csv
vintage: current snapshot as of fetch (not a time series)
notes: qualifying-runway count = open, paved runways >= 5,000 ft; community-maintained, not an FAA facility record; enplanements_per_runway is a rough proxy, not capacity.
